dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents, as of 28 Aug 2019 over White Nile State, Sudan
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20190815SDN** This map illustrates satellite-detected surface water in White Nile District, Sudan as observed from SPOT-6 imagery acquired on 28 August 2019. Within the analysed area of about 240 sq km, a total 35 sq km of lands appear to be flooded as of 28 August 2019. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.
